_meta.description: Bundled offline vulnerability advisory database for IronClad Sentinel. This is a curated, illustrative subset of well-known, publicly disclosed advisories used for offline dependency scanning. Update this file periodically from public advisory sources (OSV, NVD, GHSA) during your own release process -- IronClad Sentinel itself never fetches it over the network at scan time.
_meta.provenance: Curated by hand from public advisory sources (NVD/GHSA). This is a deliberately small, verifiable subset, not a full feed; production installations should point `advisory_path` at their own maintained overlay directory or an internal OSV mirror.

django.summary: Potential ReDoS in EmailValidator/URLValidator due to catastrophic backtracking.
SQL injection in QuerySet.order_by() via column aliasing on Oracle.

flask.summary: Session cookie disclosure to a different domain when a large number of same-site subdomains are involved.

requests.summary: Proxy-Authorization header leak on cross-origin redirects.

pyyaml.summary: yaml.full_load / unsafe FullLoader allowed arbitrary code execution via crafted YAML.
Default Loader in yaml.load() allowed arbitrary code execution.

pillow.summary: Arbitrary code execution via crafted ImageMath eval expressions.
Arbitrary code execution when a program passes attacker-controlled data to PIL.ImageMath.eval.

urllib3.summary: Cookie header not stripped on cross-origin redirect.

jinja2.summary: Sandbox breakout via crafted template filenames in Xattr-based caching.
Cross-site scripting via the xmlattr filter when an attribute key contains spaces.

cryptography.summary: NULL pointer dereference when loading PKCS7 certificates with certain malformed data.
NULL pointer dereference when loading a malformed PKCS7 blob, crashing the process.

pyjwt.summary: Algorithm confusion could allow forged tokens when multiple key types are configured.

paramiko.summary: Terrapin attack allows prefix truncation in SSH extension negotiation.
Terrapin attack: SSH prefix truncation via extension negotiation message injection.

werkzeug.summary: High resource consumption when parsing multipart forms with many parts, enabling denial of service.

aiohttp.summary: Directory traversal in static file serving when follow_symlinks is enabled without a root check.

certifi.summary: Removal of the e-Tugra root certificate following a security investigation of the CA.

setuptools.summary: Code injection via the package_index download helper when installing from an untrusted index.

idna.summary: Regular-expression denial of service when decoding a very long internationalized domain name.

zipp.summary: Infinite loop when iterating a specially crafted zip archive, causing denial of service.

tqdm.summary: CLI argument injection when tqdm.cli is invoked with untrusted arguments.

lodash.summary: Prototype pollution in defaultsDeep allowing modification of Object.prototype.

express.summary: Prototype pollution via qs dependency in query string parsing.
Open redirect in res.location/res.redirect when the URL starts with a malformed protocol.

axios.summary: XSRF-TOKEN leaked to third-party host when following cross-origin redirects.
XSRF-TOKEN leaked to third-party hosts on cross-site requests.

minimist.summary: Prototype pollution via constructor and __proto__ keys.
Prototype pollution when parsing crafted command-line arguments.

jsonwebtoken.summary: Insecurely configured secret retrieval function could lead to arbitrary code execution.
Insecure key handling allowed authentication bypass when verifying tokens with an insecure public key.

moment.summary: ReDoS via crafted locale-aware date parsing strings.
Inefficient regular expression complexity leading to denial of service when parsing dates.

node-fetch.summary: Exposure of sensitive information due to insufficient referrer/redirect policy handling.
Authorization header not stripped when following a cross-origin redirect.

semver.summary: ReDoS in range parsing regular expressions.

braces.summary: Uncontrolled resource consumption when parsing deeply nested brace expansions.

follow-redirects.summary: Proxy-Authorization header leaked to the destination host when following a redirect.

cross-spawn.summary: Regular expression denial of service when parsing crafted command arguments.

nanoid.summary: Infinite loop when a zero-length alphabet is supplied, hanging the process.

path-to-regexp.summary: Regular expression denial of service with unbounded wildcards in a route pattern.

github.com/gin-gonic/gin.summary: Trusted proxies not correctly evaluated, allowing header spoofing.

golang.org/x/crypto.summary: Terrapin attack: SSH extension negotiation message injection.

golang.org/x/net.summary: Excessive resource consumption via a malicious HTTP/2 client (rapid reset).

rails.summary: Possible XSS vulnerability in the translation helper of Action View.

json.summary: Denial of service via deeply nested JSON causing stack exhaustion.

guzzlehttp/guzzle.summary: Authorization header not stripped on cross-domain redirect.

phpmailer/phpmailer.summary: Object injection through a crafted PHAR attachment path.

org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core.summary: Log4Shell: JNDI lookup allows remote code execution via crafted log messages.

com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-datab.summary: Denial of service via deeply nested arrays/objects when polymorphic typing is enabled.

org.springframework:spring-core.summary: Remote code execution via data binding on JDK 9+ (Spring4Shell).

time.summary: Data race in localtime_r usage when called from multiple threads.

smallvec.summary: Double free / use-after-free when inserting into a spilled SmallVec.

newtonsoft.json.summary: Denial of service when deserializing deeply nested JSON payloads.
